functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Sets mail.dark-reader.enabled (only if it differs, to avoid a needless re-render).

functions.name: watchTab
functions.description: Attaches a change listener to the dark reader toggle in the given tab's message pane (once per pane).

functions.name: setNote
functions.description: Shows or hides the small 'Auto' label next to the toggle in the given tab.

events.name: onUserToggled
events.description: Fired when the user clicks the dark reader toggle by hand.
